visual_action: A slideshow of two still images set in what appears to be the chamber of the U.S. House of Representatives. The first image shows Donald Trump in the foreground, with a digitally altered background where a man holds a sign reading "BLACK PEOPLE ARENT APES!". The second image shows Representative Al Green from a different angle, standing and pointing a long object at another person.

cast.name: Al Green
cast.evidence: He is named in the on-screen text, "Rep. Al Green interrupting Trump at SOTU, 2026" and "Rep. Al Green interrupting Trump at SOTU, 2025", and is depicted in both images (one of which is manipulated).

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is clearly visible in the foreground of the first image and is named in the on-screen text, "Rep. Al Green interrupting Trump at SOTU...".

on_screen_text.text: Rep. Al Green interrupting Trump at SOTU, 2026
Rep. Al Green interrupting Trump at SOTU, 2025

spoken_summary: The video has no spoken words, only a musical track.
audio_music: A slow, somber, and melancholic instrumental track plays throughout the video.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow consisting of two still images with a direct cut between them.
manipulation_or_satire: The first image is a digitally manipulated composite. A figure, identified by text as Rep. Al Green, is shown holding a sign reading 'BLACK PEOPLE ARENT APES!'. This figure and sign are crudely superimposed into a photograph of the House chamber, with distorted hands indicating it is a fabrication.
central_claim: A potential second Trump presidency would be characterized by racial strife and protest, as evidenced by this fabricated depiction of Rep. Al Green confronting Trump at a future State of the Union address.
intended_effect: To generate opposition to Donald Trump by associating him with racism and portraying a future presidency under him as chaotic and divisive.
